items.en: Card settings now look like the rest of Settings, and every form dialog has a Cancel button next to its main action.
items.zh: 卡片设置改为与设置页一致的样式，所有表单弹窗都在主按钮旁提供“取消”。

items.en: Calendar export is now a menu with image or PDF (with a live preview), calendar file and subscription link.
items.zh: 日历导出改为菜单，包含图片或 PDF（带实时预览）、日历文件和订阅链接。

items.en: Each program now has one calendar subscription link that you can copy any time, change what it includes, or reset.
items.zh: 每个学业项目现在只有一个日历订阅链接，可随时复制、调整包含的内容，也能重置。

items.en: The calendar week view now matches the timetable's look.
items.zh: 日历周视图的样式与课表统一。

items.en: Clearer, more consistent wording across the interface.
items.zh: 统一并精简了界面文案。

items.en: Fixed the week number in the calendar, the day order in exported images for Sunday-start weeks, and the time format in month view.
items.zh: 修正了日历中的周次、周日起始时导出图片的日期顺序，以及月视图的时间格式。

items.en: Limited how many times a sign-in code can be checked for one email address per day, to better protect accounts.
items.zh: 限制了同一邮箱每天校验验证码的次数，更好地保护账户安全。
